documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: We are an existing customer in facilities management. Our workflow stopped after a configuration change. Please get support involved before discussing expansion. This is a support incident.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer is an existing Cedar Systems user in facilities management who is experiencing workflow disruption due to a recent configuration change. They explicitly stated that support should be involved before any discussion of expansion, indicating this is a support incident rather than a new sales opportunity.

claims.quote: Please get support involved before discussing expansion.

raw_proposal.draft: We understand that your workflow has stopped following a configuration change, and we appreciate your request to involve support before any further discussion. Our support team is available to assist with resolving this issue. Please provide any additional details that may help us address the disruption in your facilities management workflow.
questions: Can you provide more details about the configuration change that caused the workflow disruption?
Have you already contacted Cedar Systems support for assistance with this issue?
uncertainties: The nature and scope of the configuration change are not specified.
